8e92ee6c Merged changes from POLYGLOT_FILEMANAGER_IMPL.
f70e620a Bugfixes: several JL5 AST nodes forgot to visit/reconstruct "name" child which led to problems when rewriting AST nodes to output to a different extension.
8aa95832 Do not automatically add the parent directory of  source file to the source path.
c1ae5c16 Added method for setting options from another options object.  Useful for when extensions pass ASTs (and options) to other extensions.
5f7a0788 Added -g option for getting javac to generate debugging info.
da205381 Added one option -mergestrings to parse concatenated string literals into one single string literal, so to avoid generating a huge AST, e.g., for parsing the action table of the generated Grm.java.
2cdfd9a7 In Swift, assuming -d to mean -D if only -d is specified. This generates the client and server classes in separate directories, as it should.
27966175 Updated copyright notice.
70244596 New command line options for output directories: -D can be used to specify the output directory for *.java files, while -d remains the output directory for *.class files. If only one of the two is given, both directories are set to be the same. That is, if only -d is given, the current behavior of placing both the *.java and *.class files into the specified directory is maintained.
b622f7dc Propagated Steve's changes from the DATAFLOW_2_0 branch.  Steve's CVS commit comments follow.
c7057158 Dealt with some Eclipse warnings.
55568ed1 Added copyright notice to source files.
75c73bdf Allow code generation from ambiguous and untyped ASTs.  Existing subclasses of Translator should extend TypedTranslator instead if they need to a context. Removed -outputamb command-line option, since now redundant.
484928e6 Added a new option "-simpleoutput" for using SimpleCodeWriter instead of OptimalCodeWriter, which causes stack overflow when polyglot base compiler is compiled.
07ca4e16 Moved classes in polyglot.ext.jl.* to polyglot.*.
84a161cf Run the post compiler with the classpath passed in on the command-line.
0fff53b9 Added a help message for -outputamb.
a53855c3 Added some high-level breaks for those hard-to-format cases.
f1972925 Added an option -outputamb to allow output directly from ambiguous nodes. Ambiguous nodes now check for the flag, and only throw exceptions when the flag is not set.
f1e751d8 Added command-line option -preferclassfiles to use class files even if the source file is newer.
55b9d0c2 Goals now have a method to return their distance from the goal.  This is typically just 0 or 1, but some goals such as Disambiguated return the number of ambiguous nodes in the AST.  The scheduler will abort the compilation if a goal is attempted twice with no progress (that is reduction in distance) made between attempts.
a68571fc Tweaked '-dump' option and added '-print' option:
5e6b8ebb Requested by Laurie Hendren: Allow more than one source file extension. ExtensionInfo now has a method fileExtensions() which returns an array of strings.  fileExtensions defaults to defaultFileExtensions(), which defaults to an array containing just defaultFileExtension().  A user can specify multiple file extensions by passing the -sx option multiple times.
a87e9aa9 Provided some utility methods for displaying usage information, to help standardize the display of usage info.
95f29848 Make usage info agree with the command line options we actually accept.
a467d956 Added dependency tracking between source jobs, by using the caching resolver to record which jobs request which types. ParsedClassType now records if it was loaded form a source file, and if so, what source file.
7b778261 Prevent duplicates from occuring on the sourcepath, to reduce time spent searching on the sourcepath.
d0867e02 Made should_report more efficient, by adding a flag to indicate if we are doing any reporting at all. In normal execution, no reporting is done, so this makes the should_report method a lot more efficient; given that it is called so much, this actually has quite an impact on Polyglot performance.
a277d2db Replaced System.exit() calls with the throwing of an exception, which is caught in Main.main(). This allows the cleaner incorporation of Polyglot into the Ant framework.
10516b01 If we are discarding output files, then set the output width to a high number, to reduce the amount of time spent in the CodeWriter. Maybe a better solution would be to use a different (more naive) code writer if we are discarding output files.
38df30d6 Applied Patrick Lam's patch to allow command-line arguments to be given in a file.
90fa2ff0 Javadoc cleanup.
c378d417 Factored out the post compiler classpath, and put it into the Options class.
cc14f518 Modified the Options class to allow extensions to extend it.
b904b34f Added -extclass to usage.
d6f1247a Added command line option -bootclasspath to the base compiler, and added a method to Options to concatenate the different pieces of the classpath in the right order.
f6fe7d8d Added "-disable <pass>" option.
be9bc5b1 A Jed special: changed -dump option to take the name of a pass. The AST is dumped after that pass runs.  Can give option multiple times to dump the AST multiple times.
ae1dd2cd Removed references to jl.ExtensionInfo from the base compiler so that we can build the base separately from the jl extension.
bc081652 Support for the new assert statement in Java 1.4.  Since this is disabled by default in javac, I disabled it in jlc by default.  You must compile with jlc -assert -post 'javac -source 1.4' using a JDK 1.4 javac.  If you don't add these options but the source file has assertions, the source file will still compile, but the output java code will not contain asserts.
5dc3fb9c Merged in RELEASE_0_9_0 branch.
3fbb37ad "jltools" -> "polyglot" name change.
1e5e7ebe Fixed non-portable default classpath.
85cf56b3 Implemented -classpath.  This required rolling our own class file parser.  Why?  Otherwise classes in packages starting with "java." can never be loaded from the classpath--they will always be loaded from the classpath in which the jlc compiler is running.  This would prevent us from writing Jif interfaces for "java.lang" and "java.io" classes without keeping the source code around.  LoadedClassType and friends are now obsolete.
2416a826 Restored -dump option to working status.
ef72b743 Bug fixes, runtime support for Jif, some initial work to get split rewriter compile.
8694d224 "The Bomb"
6dcdf39d Changed reporting a bit. Reporting is now factored out into main.Report, and options are in main.Options. This change disentangles some of the dependencies that required that everything in jltools be built in order for anything to be built.
96c2c0f0 Reimplemented the frontend.  Removed ClassTypeJob and moved functionality into the TypeSystem (cleanClass).  Removed MainTargetFactory.  TargetFactory is now only responsible for creating the output stream for a given output file.  This permits multiple output files per source file.  SourceLoader is responsible for loading source files (Source).
1f69014c Missing file.

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** I traced the history of `src/polyglot/main/Options.java` using `git log --follow -p` and `git log -S` to find every commit touching the `addBootCP` method and the `bootclasspathDirectories().addAll(...)` line the fix modifies.

**(2) The introducing change:** Commit `0d968cce` ("Be less draconian about setting classpath/bootclasspath etc. add useful 'addbootcp' option...") added the entire `-addbootcp` feature: the CLI flag, its dispatch in `handleArg`, and the new `addBootCP(List<File> value)` method, implemented as:
```java
protected void addBootCP(List<File> value) {
    bootclasspathDirectories().addAll(value);
}
```
Crucially, this same commit's own flag description states: `"prepend <path> to the bootclasspath"`. The implementation appends to the end of the list instead of prepending (index 0), directly contradicting the documented/intended semantics of the flag. This mismatch is precisely what commit `734fedf3` fixes by changing `addAll(value)` to `addAll(0, value)`.

**(3) Supporting evidence:**
- `git log -S "addBootCP" --follow` shows `0d968cce` is the *only* commit (besides the fix itself) that ever touched the `addBootCP` string/method — the method was never modified in between, so the bug persisted unchanged for the entire 2012–2016 interval.
- The full diff of `0d968cce` shows the flag's help text explicitly promising "prepend" behavior while the code appends — a clear semantic bug introduced at creation time, not a regression from some later refactor.
- No other commit touching `bootclasspathDirectories`/`addBootCP` exists between `0d968cce` and `734fedf3` in the file's `--follow` history.

I'm highly confident in this attribution — the flag's own documentation contradicts its implementation from the moment it was introduced, and the code path was untouched until the fix.
